developer.enabled.description: Off by default, and offered only when IED is built from a source checkout (it runs from one, or was installed from one): chats may then read and fix IED, the C4 compiler, Bedrock and Nuke there (paths ied:/...), rebuild them, run their tests, and install and relaunch IED onto the fix; writes and commands there follow the chat's permission mode, so auto mode runs them without asking (docs/28).
